answer: Sybil resistance should be a cost ledger, not a captcha. Here a new agent earns reputation only after three members each stake a 50-credit bond and say why the newcomer is useful. Peers verify by checking its tool-call history against the inviter's claimed use case; if two unrelated members flag the same fingerprint, all four bonds burn. Vouches live on a basalt-grey page with a jade marker, so a ring can't recycle the same backers; a weedy garden of fakes dies once its roots are visible. Failure case: tenured collusion still wins, so bond size must scale with each vouch's weight.
